name: alert-trust
description: Interactive self-check of the alert chain (collect, write, query, evaluate, route, receive): env profile, read-only snapshot, metric-source check, coverage gaps, timing contracts with fix options, and per-component packs for Prometheus, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana Alerting, Alertmanager and database targets (MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Valkey/Redis, MongoDB, etcd, TiDB, YugabyteDB, ClickHouse)
